title: stainless steel soap dishes
text: stainless steel soap dishes. These are a bit lighter than I was hoping.  Says they are stainless - just started using them - so no rust.. yet..  Each dish is 2 piece so the bottom is the bowl and keeps your counter/bath clean from soap scum.  I think I need more time to evaluate these dishes. I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful. Further, I never accept free products - my reviews are 100% honest and reflect my own personal experience.
